decisions.rationale: van der Woude syndrome is a single, named specific syndrome with one definition and is not a family of diseases.
Cleft palate in the title is a single defined malformation used as a disease entity (susceptibility locus for cleft palate), not a modifier.
Repeated full-name mention of van der Woude syndrome in the abstract; duplicate mentions are annotated separately.
VWS is the abbreviation of van der Woude syndrome and is annotated as its own synonymous mention.
Cleft lip / palate is treated as one recognized orofacial cleft condition with its own abbreviation CL / P, not a composite of separate diseases here.
CL / P is the abbreviation of cleft lip / palate and is annotated as a separate synonymous mention.
Cleft palate listed as a clinical feature of VWS is a specific disease mention with a single definition.
CP is the abbreviation of cleft palate and is annotated as a separate synonymous mention.
Bifid uvula is a specific congenital anomaly with its own definition and is not a general term.
Hypodontia is a specific dental developmental anomaly with a single definition.
H is the abbreviation defined in parentheses after hypodontia and is annotated as a separate synonymous mention.
VWS used as a disease name in the expression of VWS refers to the syndrome itself and is not modifying another noun.
Repeated mention of CL / P as a disease in the occurrence of CL / P within the same sentence context; duplicates are annotated.
CP refers to cleft palate as a disease occurring within the genealogy and is a specific disease mention.
CP refers to cleft palate as the disease with a recurrence risk among descendants and is a specific disease mention.
VWS names the disease in descendants with VWS and is not a modifier of another noun.
Clefts refers generically to a family of cleft malformations (cleft lip and cleft palate) rather than one specific disease with a single definition.
decisions.guideline_section: 1. Annotate all Specific Disease mentions (Disease Class definition)

decisions.rationale: Syndrome is a very general term that is excluded when it stands alone without a specific disease name.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4. Do not annotate general terms

decisions.rationale: VWS names the disease in the kindred with VWS and is not used to modify another noun.
CP refers to cleft palate as the affected phenotype in the individuals with CP and is a specific disease mention.
VWS names the disease in clinical signs of VWS and is not used as a modifier of another noun.
VWS modifies the noun gene (the VWS gene), so it is a disease name used as a modifier for another concept.
decisions.guideline_section: 3. Annotate disease mentions that are used as Modifiers

decisions.rationale: CP names cleft palate as the phenotype in the probability of CP and is not modifying another noun.
VWS modifies the noun pedigrees (other VWS pedigrees), so it is a disease name used as a modifier.
